title: Signal: Network error text discloses an internal address and port

check.valuePattern: (?:dial tcp|connect: connection refused|upstream connect error|no route to host|connection to server at)[^\n]{0,120}?(?:10\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|192\.168\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|172\.(?:1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}):\d{2,5}

scope: One response body containing a network-failure phrase immediately followed by a private IPv4 address and port.
limitations: One response body. The check cannot tell a documentation example from a live address, and it does not probe the address.

observation.body: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers: 10.24.8.19:8080
pool exhausted: connect: connection refused while dialling 172.18.0.3:6379
pool exhausted: connect: connection refused while dialling 203.0.113.10:6379

fpNotes: A health or status page that lists private addresses without a failure phrase is not reported, because that is a deliberate diagnostic surface already covered by the console rules; a public address is not reported.
